user.title: Garden Irrigation
user.description: Connect a Garden Irrigation Wi-Fi/MQTT controller. If the controller is already online, it should be discovered automatically from its retained identity.

mqtt_confirm.title: Discovered Garden Irrigation controller
mqtt_confirm.description: Home Assistant found `{device_id}` on MQTT topic `{base_topic}`. Board: `{board}`. Chip: `{chip}`.

error.controller_not_found: No retained Garden Irrigation identity was detected on this MQTT base topic.
error.identity_mismatch: The retained controller identity does not match the requested controller name or base topic.

abort.already_configured: This Garden Irrigation controller is already configured.
abort.invalid_discovery_payload: The discovered MQTT identity payload is not valid Garden Irrigation identity.
abort.discovery_expired: The discovered controller identity is no longer available. Start discovery again.

init.title: Garden Irrigation options
init.description: Configure the optional weather guard used by local schedules. Leave empty to disable weather-based blocking.

error.invalid_weather_entity: Use a Home Assistant weather entity, for example weather.forecast_home.
